paraphrase.firstSampling: HIV1/2,HBV andHCV markers for concerned persons (both couple members if applicable) within six months before the first relevant event: collection/retrieval for parental AMP or non-medical conservation; first donated-gamete insemination/embryo transfer; first fertility-preservation gamete/tissue collection; first use of fertility-preserved gametes/tissues.
paraphrase.repeat: Repeat testing is required when interviews identify an intervening contamination risk.
paraphrase.footnote93: Attempt means insemination,IVF,embryo transfer or gamete collection for future use underL2141-12. This definition does not add a three-month limit.
paraphrase.thirdParty: II-5.2 expressly concerns third-party gamete donors. For sperm, repeat markers at donation/last collection plus genomic testing, or repeat after six months where genomic testing absent, determine release. These separate third-party rules should not be assumed to cure the first partner-sampling interval.
